name: Cactus Deermouse
desc: Cactus Deermouse (Peromyscus eremicus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The cactus mouse or cactus deermouse is a species of rodent in the family Cricetidae. It is a species of the genus Peromyscus, a closely related group of New World mice often called "deermice".
